beta.posture: Admitted with explicit provider-beta warning and approval-always on every beta mutation; private beta routes may still require account enablement.

auth.selected: Mollie API key, advanced access token, or OAuth access token stored as encrypted bearer authority.
auth.scope_intersection_resolution: required_scopes contains only scopes present in every documented credential alternative; exact alternatives remain in each operation contract.

idempotency.official_contract: All Mollie POST endpoints accept Idempotency-Key; keys replay the cached response for one hour.

pagination.contract: Mollie returns an opaque absolute _links.next.href while the request accepts only its from token; the current catalog cannot parse query values out of URLs, so every walk stays explicit and single-page.

root_source_pin.reason: The root spans seven independently updated OpenAPI documents, and the official public site exposes each complete document only inside server-rendered page data rather than at a stable raw OpenAPI URL. The generator extracts and hash-locks all seven exact schemas instead of attaching a misleading single source pin.

source_posture.reason: Mollie financial, payment, customer, mandate, subscription, webhook, account, settlement, payout, and invoice records are not user-work task, note, or project entities.

audit_findings_folded.finding: One OpenAPI pin cannot honestly cover seven independently updated Mollie definitions.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Split admitted capabilities into six version-pinned dependency packs, omitted misleading manifest pins, and hash-locked all seven extracted official schemas in one deterministic fixture.

audit_findings_folded.finding: OAuth token lifecycle uses Basic Auth instead of the family bearer authority.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Excluded both token routes and kept credential minting and revocation outside callable operation args.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Business-account transfer creation requires exact-body request signing.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Excluded create-transfer until a connection-owned signer can derive X-Client-Signature and X-Client-Signed-At without exposing signing authority.

audit_findings_folded.finding: All fifteen Orders operations are provider-deprecated.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Excluded the complete Orders document and admitted the current Payments, refunds, captures, and payment-link replacements.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Submit onboarding data is discouraged in prose but not marked deprecated in OpenAPI.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Excluded the write and admitted the provider-recommended Client Links operation.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Retrying money movement or recurring creation without a stable idempotency key can duplicate effects.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Requires a bounded caller-owned Idempotency-Key on every new POST and classifies each as idempotent under Mollie’s documented one-hour replay contract.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Authorization, signature headers, and arbitrary targets are operation-level authority.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Keeps bearer, signing headers, host, user-agent, and base URLs outside callable arguments; the signed route fails closed.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Permissive path IDs can inject delimiters, percent escapes, controls, or empty segments.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Bounds every generated path segment and replaces unsafe provider patterns with an unreserved-character contract.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Complex JSON bodies can lose nested fields, unions, nulls, or unsafe integers when flattened.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Uses bounded body_raw for complex, freeform, union, oversized, or unsafe-integer bodies and recursively closed projection for small documentary objects.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Mollie credential alternatives cannot be represented by one flat required_scopes list.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Publishes only the exact scope intersection and preserves every API-key, advanced-token, and OAuth alternative in audit evidence.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Opaque HAL next links cannot be copied directly into the from query parameter.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Leaves pagination explicit, returns only the documented _embedded collection, and tells callers to extract the from token manually.

audit_findings_folded.finding: The method amount filter is a deep-object query and the payout cursor omits an explicit OpenAPI type.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Expands the amount filter into bracketed currency and value query arguments and infers the payout from cursor as a bounded string from its official example.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Private-beta and beta operations may not be enabled for every account.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Retains full callable coverage but labels every provider-beta operation and requires approval on every beta mutation.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Filling the compatibility root with new reads would widen established default read grants.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Keeps root additions action-only and places all new reads in feature dependencies with zero cache.

audit_findings_folded.finding: The old compatibility surface accepted lossy response integers, while blindly closing its free-form metadata objects would break callers.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Adds unsafe-integer string parsing and only type-faithful closed request schemas; the two established free-form metadata writes deliberately keep their original open request contract.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Financial and control-plane records do not prove task, note, or project Source semantics.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Publishes no work_entity_sources and records the exact reason.
